definition: Midpoint of each CAD jaw distal-end bounding-box center at nominal closed angle; distal vertices within 1 micrometre of minimum gripper-frame Y. Fixed closed-gripper reference, not opening-dependent contact center.
orientation: Inherits gripper frame; not a calibrated grasp orientation
limitation: Actual closure angle, jaw geometry and contact point require physical verification; base pose inherits arm model errors.
